decisions.reason: As an adjacent cloud contact-centre service that fits the firm's digital-transformation direction and can be supported with existing network, cloud and service capabilities, it remains a relatively low-cost option to keep open because there is still no clear evidence that its value has failed to emerge.

Because the routing platform is very close to the established connectivity and voice offer, likely inexpensive to maintain on existing infrastructure, and still offers upside while demand information continues to accumulate, management would keep it on the market rather than abandon it now.
